mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4, reducing amiodarone metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while amiodarone may inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism; both drugs prolong QT interval and have proarrhythmic potential.
action: Monitor ECG and amiodarone levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant or reduce amiodarone dose; assess QTc interval regularly due to additive cardiac effects.
